desc:
Welcome to Wildwood Tea House! ☕ Invite your friends for tea time and enjoy a wide variety of delightful desserts.

👍 Like the game for updates!

🍰 Eat desserts to earn points and cash!
👨‍🍳 Take on roles such as waiter and baker!
🎁 Purchase crates to unlock exclusive skins!
🌳 Enjoy the serene environment!
⌛ Playtime rewards given every 5 minutes!
🔥 Daily streaks! Come back everyday for daily rewards!


🔔 Don't forget to hit the FOLLOW button to be notified when new updates are available! Or follow us on the social media platforms listed below!

✨ Join our group for 2X DAILY REWARDS!

More playtime rewards for Premium users!

Thanks for playing our game and enjoy the food! 😊
